senses.gloss:
m. (-ण्डः)
1 The belly.
2 The back of an animal.
E.
अपि certainly, चम to eat, aff. ड, initial of the prefix rejected; also पिचिण्ड.

mfn. (-लः-ला-लं)
Bigbellied, corpulent.
E.
पिचण्ड the belly, and इलच् aff.

f. (-का)
The instep; also पिचिण्डिका.

m. (-व्यः)
The cotton plant.
E.
पिचु cotton, and यत् aff.

m. (-ण्डः)
1 The belly or abdomen.
2 The back of an animal.
E.
अपि certainly, चम to eat, aff. ड, and इ substituted for the radical vowel.

mfn. (-लः-ला-लं)
Bigbellied, corpulent, potbellied.
E.
पिचिण्ड a belly, and इलच् aff.

m. (-चुः)
1 Cotton.
2 The name of an Asura.
3 A Karṣa or weight of two Tolas: see कर्ष.
4 A sort of leprosy.
5 One of the eight faces of BHAIRAVA.
E.
पिच Sautra root, to rub, Uṇādi aff. उ.

m. (-कः)
A plant, (Vangueria spinosa.)
E.
कन् added to the preceding.

n. (-लं)
Cotton.
E.
पिचु and तूल both meaning the same, cotton.

m. (-न्दः)
The Nimb tree, (Melia azadirachta.)
E.
पिचु a sort of leprosy, and मन्द to be slow, in the causal form, to make slow or check, aff. अच्; also पिचुमर्द्द.

m. (-र्द्दः)
The Nimb tree: see the last.
E.
पिचु as before, मृद to destroy, aff. अच्.

m. (-लः)
1 Cotton; also पिचु.
2 The tamarisk, (T. Indica.)
3 A plant, (Barringtonia acutangula.)
4 The diver or water-crow.
E.
पिचु cotton, ला to get, &c. aff. क.

r. 1st cl. (पिच्चति)
To cut, to divide.

n. (-चं)
The lower jaw, the chin.

m. (-टः)
1 Tin.
2 Lead.
3 Inflammation of the eyes, ophthalmia.
E.
पिच्च to divide, aff. अच्, and ढौक for ढौक to go, aff. ड.

r. 6th cl. (पिच्छति)
1 To pain or torture.
2 To hinder.
r. 10th cl. (पिच्छयति)
To cut, to divide.

n. (-च्छं)
1 The tail of a peacock.
2 A crest.
m. (-च्छः)
A tail in general.
f. (-च्छा)
1 The gum of the silk cotton tree.
2 A line, a row or range.
3 A diseased affection of a horse's feet.
4 The nut of the Areca, betel nut.
5 A plantain.
6 The scum of boiled rice.
7 A sort of body dress, or jacket.
8 The venomous saliva of a snake.
9 The Sisu tree, (Dalbergia Sisu.)
10 A sheath, a coat or cover.
E.
पिच्छ to divide, aff. घञ् or अच्.

f. (-ला)
The jujube, (Zizyphus jujuba.)
E.
पिच्छल for पिच्छिल a tree, and दल a leaf.

mfn. (-वान्-वती-वत्)
Tailed, having a tail.
E.
पिच्छ, and मतुप् aff.

m. (-णः)
A hawk.

f. (-का)
The Sisu, (Dalbergia Sisu.)

mfn. subst. (-लः-ला-लं)
1 Sauce mixed with rice gruel.
2 Sauce, gravy, or condiments with water or Ghee.
3 Broth, soup.
4 Moist, and split pulse.
f. (-ला)
1 The silk cotton tree, (Bombax heptaphyllum.)
2 A potherb, (Basella rubra and lucida.)
3 A timber tree, (Dalbergia Sisu.)
4 The name of a river.
5 An esculent root, (Arum Indicum.)
m. (-लः)
The tamarisk, (Tamarix Indica).
mfn. adj. (-लः-ला-लं)
Having a tail.
E.
पिच्छा rice water, scum, &c. and इलच् aff.

m. (-त्वक्)
1 An orange.
2 Orange peel.
E.
पिच्छिल said to mean an orange, and त्वच् skin.
